title: Cash deposits clustered immediately below the currency transaction reporting threshold
definition: Cash deposits that cluster immediately below the applicable currency transaction reporting threshold, across dispersed branches or accounts, within a single monitoring window. The indicator describes a measured pattern. It does not describe intent, and it is not on its own evidence of a reporting violation.
evidence_to_cite: the individual deposit records, each cited by its own source id and pointer
the threshold value in force for the monitoring window
the subject's declared business profile, where one exists
benign_explanations: A cash-intensive legitimate business depositing daily takings below the reporting threshold.
A business splitting a deposit across branches for operational reasons such as a branch's daily cash limit.
Seasonal or end-of-week cash takings that cluster below the threshold by coincidence of trading volume.
A recently formed business whose declared cash intensity is lower than its actual takings.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, Currency Transaction Reporting requirements as summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.

notes: The benign explanations are the most valuable part of this record. An indicator without them is a detector with no false-positive population.
